chunks: Only they ask (for leave) who do not believe in God and the Last Day, whose hearts are full of doubt; and doubting they waver (between gain and loss).
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that ask for leave to stay behind according to Surah At-Tawbah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual root of hypocrisy (munafiqun) as internal doubt (taraddud) rather than mere external disobedience, linking their hesitation to a lack of firm conviction in the Hereafter. It serves as a diagnostic criterion for distinguishing between the sincere believer and the hypocrite whose heart is unsettled by worldly attachments.
